gloss: change of registered domicile; transfer of family register

definitions.gloss: change of registered domicile; transfer of family register
definitions.explanation: Moving one's official family register (koseki) to a different municipality. In Japan, every family has a registered domicile (honseki) that is separate from the actual address of residence. Transferring this registration is a bureaucratic procedure done at city hall.

definitions.gloss: transfer to another company or organization
definitions.explanation: In a business context, a permanent transfer of employment from one company to another, often between affiliated companies within a corporate group. Unlike temporary secondment, the employee's affiliation changes completely.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転籍|てんせき}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I transferred my family register when I got married.

examples.japanese: {転籍届|てんせきとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{本籍地|ほんせきち}→本籍地：16666_honsekichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転籍|てんせき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん}→戸籍謄本：10286_kosekitouhon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you transfer your registered domicile to your current address, it becomes more convenient to obtain copies of your family register.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子会社|こがいしゃ}→子会社：12258_kogaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転籍|てんせき}になった。
examples.english: I was permanently transferred to a subsidiary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{定年|ていねん}→定年：07500_teinen⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関連|かんれん}{会社|がいしゃ}→関連会社：19758_kanrengaisha⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{転籍|てんせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打診|だしん}→打診：05831_dashin⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Before retirement, I was approached about a permanent transfer to an affiliated company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出向|しゅっこう}→出向：07110_shukkou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違う：01957_chigau⟧、{転籍|てんせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: Unlike secondment, with a permanent transfer the employment relationship with the original company is completely severed.

notes:
Composed of {転|てん} (transfer, change) and {籍|せき} (register, membership). The two senses share the core idea of officially moving one's registration from one place to another.

The family register sense (sense 1) is specific to Japan's koseki system. Everyone in Japan has a ⟦{本籍地|ほんせきち}→本籍地：16666_honsekichi⟧ (registered domicile) that may differ from their actual residence. Transferring the register is typically done after marriage, divorce, or simply for convenience.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転籍届|てんせきとどけ}: domicile transfer notification form
- ⟦{本籍地|ほんせきち}→本籍地：16666_honsekichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転籍|てんせき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to transfer one's registered domicile
- ⟦{子会社|こがいしゃ}→子会社：12258_kogaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転籍|てんせき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to transfer permanently to a subsidiary
- {転籍|てんせき}{先|さき}: destination of transfer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出向|しゅっこう}→出向：07110_shukkou⟧: secondment — temporary assignment to another company, with the original employment maintained
- ⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧: personnel transfer — broader term covering transfers within the same organization
- ⟦{転勤|てんきん}→転勤：04555_tenkin⟧: job transfer (to a different location) — moving to a different office of the same company
